design: A sly adult human hooded cultist dungeon adversary, stylized same proportions as player mages. Deep plum hood and ragged burgundy/dark-purple medieval robes with restrained tarnished brass trim, leather belt, dark gloves and boots. Shadowed face with medium narrow amber eyes, sharp nose, a visible spiteful crooked grin; not a faceless horror. A small bone pendant and ONE short twisted iron ritual dagger in foreground hand, far hand making a taunting claw gesture. Exactly two arms and two legs. Idle planted boots with subtle breathing/blink, hurt angry recoil while retaining dagger, attack winds dagger back then jabs/slashes toward RIGHT, dodge bends backward and crouches with dagger close. Same clothes and weapon all16frames. No floating spell effects, gore or cute baby features. Generous cell padding matching reference two.
prompt:
STYLE/ANATOMY REFINEMENT. Reference image ONE is the actual playable swordsman and is the EXACT standard for rendering style and grounded proportions. Reference image TWO is the enemy sprite sheet to REDRAW/REFINE. Preserve this enemy's identity, clothing, colors, equipment and ALL SIXTEEN corresponding actions in the same 4x4 layout.
The enemy currently looks too chibi/cartoonish. Make it MORE SERIOUS and proportionally grounded, matching the PLAYABLE CHARACTER reference. For adult human-like bodies use approximately FOUR to FOUR-AND-A-HALF head units of height, smaller anatomically sized head and eyes, longer natural torso/legs/forearms, credible joints and hands, restrained hostile expressions. No giant baby head, stubby child limbs, huge eyes, silly smirks, exaggerated cartoon acting, cute mascot or toy look. For nonhuman anatomy retain its species characteristics but apply the same mature serious treatment.
Keep the polished HAND-PAINTED 2D fantasy RPG finish, crisp detailed outlines and material shading of image ONE, no photorealism, gore or horror. Same side three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. An ADULT male human cultist with a natural head/eye size and mature angular face under the hood, about4.3headunits tall with longer robe-covered legs and credible forearms. Serious intent gaze, no mischievous cartoon grin or baby cheeks. Keep plum hood, burgundy robes with gold trim, small skull pendant, leather gloves/boots and the SAME ritual dagger held in foreground hand in EVERY pose including blink, hurt and dodge. Exactly two arms/two legs, preserve pose sequence and adult anatomy throughout.
Four equal columns and FOUR rows: idle, hurt, attack, dodge. Four distinct coherent poses per action. Same redesigned mature body proportions and camera scale across all16poses. Idle fixed support/body root with only slight breathing and blink. Hurt clear recoil, attack readable wind-up/strike/recovery, dodge evasion/recovery. Same weapon held visibly in EVERY pose including blink/hurt/dodge. All figures complete, ample transparent spacing between cells and outer margins, no neighbor overlap or clipping. Real transparent background, no text, grid lines, scenery, shadows or detached effects.
